plugin.note: Use an anti-icy-breath shield: elemental, mind, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield. Spitting Wyverns are fastest for quick clears; avoid Taloned and Ancient Wyverns unless accepting slower kills or targeting better drops.

requirements: 66 Slayer to kill Spitting, Taloned, and Long-tailed Wyverns
Elemental Workshop I completion for the basic shield requirement
Elemental, mind, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield equipped for icy breath reduction
Fossil Island Wyverns Slayer task for the task-only cave
mechanics: Fossil Island wyverns are draconic and dragonbane weapons are effective.
All variants use icy breath, which can hit extremely hard without the right shield.
Elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, and ancient wyvern shield reduce icy breath damage.
Only the ancient wyvern shield prevents the freezing effect from icy breath.
Anti-dragon shield and antifire potions do not work against Fossil Island wyvern icy breath.
Protect from Magic only provides half the damage reduction of shield protections.
Spitting Wyverns use melee, ranged, and icy breath; their ranged attack is weak and can hit multiple times.
Taloned, Long-tailed, and Ancient Wyverns use typeless magic that ignores protection prayers.
Long-tailed Wyverns only use their typeless magic attack when the player is out of melee distance.
Ancient Wyverns have higher stats and better drops than the other variants.

methods.label: Travel and locations
methods.summary: Choose between the regular cave near Museum Camp and the task-only cave in Mushroom Forest.
steps: Use a Digsite pendant on the House on the Hill strange machine teleport, or use a mounted digsite pendant in a Portal Nexus.
For the regular cave, run south-east from House on the Hill or use the barge and run east past the bank then south-east.
For the task-only cave, use the Magic Mushtree near House on the Hill to appear just north of the Mushroom Forest trapdoor.
Use the regular cave east of Museum Camp for 4 Spitting, 4 Taloned, 4 Long-tailed, and 2 Ancient Wyverns.
Use the task-only cave for 4 Spitting, 4 Taloned, 4 Long-tailed, and 3 Ancient Wyverns.
Use the Fossil Storage box by either entrance for fossils.
notes: Weve stops players from attacking in the task-only area without a Fossil Island Wyverns task.

methods.label: Shield protection
methods.summary: Carry the right shield for icy breath; anti-dragon and antifire protection do not work.
steps: Equip an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield before attacking.
Use ancient wyvern shield when possible because it is the only listed shield that prevents freezing from icy breath.
Do not use Anti-dragon shield for this task; Anti-dragon shield does not reduce Fossil Island wyvern icy breath.
Do not rely on antifire potions of any type; they do not mitigate icy breath.
Protect from Magic can help only partially and gives half the damage reduction of the proper shield protections.
risks: Two-handed special attacks must be timed carefully so the shield is equipped before icy breath.
Using the wrong shield can result in very high icy breath damage.

methods.label: Spitting Wyvern quick clear
methods.summary: Kill Spitting Wyverns when the goal is to finish the task quickly.
recommendedFor: Players avoiding Taloned and Ancient Wyverns
steps: Choose Spitting Wyverns because the task page identifies them as best for quick clears.
Fight from a distance and keep the anti-icy-breath shield equipped.
Use Protect from Missiles to negate their ranged attack, leaving only icy breath and any melee hits to manage.
Avoid standing in melee range if using Ranged.
Use expeditious bracelet swaps before finishing kills if completing the task as quickly as possible.
risks: Protect from Missiles does not block icy breath.
The ranged attack is weak but can hit multiple times on a successful hit.

methods.label: Melee tank
methods.summary: Tank wyverns in high ranged-defence gear with dragonbane melee and Protect from Melee.
steps: Maximise ranged Defence with Barrows, Bandos, or Justiciar-style armour.
Use a one-handed melee weapon so an anti-icy-breath shield stays equipped.
Use Protect from Melee because ranged and icy breath damage can still matter through other prayers.
Keep Long-tailed Wyverns in melee distance so they do not use their typeless magic attack.
Use Piety if the additional prayer cost is worthwhile.
Bring high-level food such as sharks or anglerfish.
risks: The ranged attack hits through protection prayers.
Removing the shield for two-handed special attacks can expose the player to icy breath.

methods.label: Prayer melee
methods.summary: Use prayer-bonus armour to sustain Protect from Melee and optional boosting prayers.
recommendedFor: Players using Proselyte or Sunfire fanatic
Players balancing Defence and Prayer bonus
steps: Wear prayer-bonus gear such as Sunfire fanatic, Proselyte, or Initiate armour.
Use Protect from Melee throughout kills.
Use Piety and optionally Preserve when faster kills justify the prayer cost.
Use Verac's equipment as a compromise when more Defence is needed with some Prayer bonus.
Bring at least one prayer potion, and more when using boosting prayers.
notes: Wyvern bones can help pay for prayer potion use.

methods.label: Magic powered staves
methods.summary: Use Magic if high Magic and upkeep budget make powered staves worthwhile.
steps: Use Magic only if the upkeep cost is acceptable.
Stand several spaces away from the wyvern to avoid melee damage.
Use Mystic Might or Augury to speed up kills.
Use Eye of ayak or Dragon hunter wand with wind spells where appropriate.
Carry rune pouch support for thralls or Wind Surge plus High Level Alchemy.
risks: Melee is usually more profitable than Magic.
Standing at distance can trigger typeless attacks from Taloned, Long-tailed, and Ancient Wyverns.

methods.label: Ranged distance
methods.summary: Use Ranged at distance, especially against Spitting Wyverns, while managing shield penalties.
steps: Use Ranged if slower but safer distance kills are acceptable.
Keep several spaces away from the wyvern to avoid melee damage.
Use Protect from Missiles specifically when killing Spitting Wyverns.
Account for the negative ranged bonuses on ancient wyvern shield and dragonfire shield.
Use dragonbane ranged weapons where available.
risks: Ranged kills are slower than melee in many setups.
Distance fighting can trigger typeless attacks from non-Spitting variants.

methods.label: Ancient Wyverns
methods.summary: Kill Ancient Wyverns only when 82 Slayer and slower, harder kills are acceptable for better drops.
steps: Only choose Ancient Wyverns if the player has 82 Slayer or accepts boosted wild-pie kills from 77 Slayer.
Use high defensive armour because Ancient Wyverns have higher Attack, Defence, and Hitpoints.
Fight in melee range with Protect from Melee when using Ranged after de-aggroing.
Use tolerance-zone setup to remove aggression if needed.
Expect better drops but slower kills than lower-level Fossil Island wyverns.
risks: Ancient Wyverns are much stronger than other Fossil Island wyverns.
Boosted kills below 82 Slayer are extremely long.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring shield, sustain, storage items, and optional alchemy or thrall support.
inventory: Anti-icy-breath shield: elemental, mind, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield
1 divine super combat potion, divine ranging potion, or imbued heart depending on style
Herb sack, especially for Ancient Wyverns
Bonecrusher if not selling wyvern bones
Book of the dead and thrall runes for Magic setups
steps: Keep the shield equipped before each icy breath attack.
Use expeditious bracelet swaps before finishing kills when trying to complete the task quickly.
Store fossils in the Fossil Storage box by the cave entrance.
Use High Level Alchemy runes where carrying alchable drops is useful.
notes: The task page lists Herb sack, Seed box, Rune pouch, and Bonecrusher as optional inventory support.
